note: Dickens County publishes no zoning districts or GIS layers; the county site mentions none. Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. The City of Spur (the county's largest city) has zoning ordinances, but its zoning boundary map is old and viewed only at City Hall, with digital maps only planned. No ArcGIS or other queryable zoning service was found for the county or Spur or Dickens town.
